title: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD on four Sparks
evidence_scope: DFlash5 draft, MXFP8 MoE and safetensors draft loader. On the MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL checkpoint and installer image dev-20260927-b12xcache-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032, NCCL extended IPv4 GIDs, which the profile sets, prefilled 8K to 128K-token prompts 11-17% faster than with them off at an unchanged decode step rate (performance/records/images/dev-20260927-b12xcache-mimo-v26-20260927.md). On installer image dev-20260928-plainstatus-cuda1342-nccl2323-status033, these settings under the test profile ID mimo-v26-flash-rl-tp4 passed all eight tool-result contract probes (performance/records/images/dev-20260928-plainstatus-mimo-v26-flash-mopd-tp4-20260928.md). On installer image dev-20261001-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on one four-Spark ring passed 7 of 7 functional checks (counting, arithmetic, code, tool calls, image, thinking) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate response, and decoded 54.5 / 204 / 332 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 4,084 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20261001-kraken-mimo-v26-flash-mopd-tp4-20261001.md). Single-run timing; not serving-qualified.
